7.3.2.1.1 Multiple Client Handling
The DM is capable of parallel processing of client requests, as long as all clients are in
the default session.
Note: The term "pseudo parallel concept" is already defined in ISO 14229-1, Annex
J, and this possibility is explicitly limited to OBD in parallel with UDS protocol. The
"pseudo parallel mode" allows other protocol combination can be processed in parallel.
Particularly the use case of parallel processing of two or more UDS protocol requests.
